title: Policy: worktrees are ephemeral — GC once value is extracted (merged + verdict); never silently orphan un-judged work
summary: DECISION on worktree lifecycle (the loop accumulated 46 empty parent dirs + 4 orphaned attempt worktrees because hold-merge mode deliberately preserves attempt worktrees for human review but has NO GC/retention backstop). PRINCIPLE: a worktree is ephemeral execution scaffolding; its durable value is extracted into (1) the winner's code merged to main and (2) the recorded verdict in the graph. Once both exist, the worktree holds nothing unique → GC it. LIFECYCLE: judged+merged/verdict → GC; loser just-judged → keep a short retention window for forensics then sweep; incomplete/un-judged (loop killed mid-flight) → NEVER silently delete, route to a 'needs attention' queue; stale + no active claim + value extracted → GC sweep candidate. The daemon already staleness-sweeps AGENTS; extend the same idea to WORKTREES. IMPLEMENTATION (this build): scripts/gc-worktrees.js, dry-run-by-default (--confirm to execute), CONSERVATIVE: GC only (a) empty parent dirs and (b) worktrees whose branch is fully merged into main AND not actively claimed AND outside the retention window; FLAG (keep) anything with unmerged commits or uncommitted changes as NEEDS-ATTENTION; SKIP active claims. This never destroys un-extracted work. The 4 current self/* attempts (code-repo-target, onboarding-kb, slim-full-graph, smoke-git-merge) all have unmerged/uncommitted work → all 4 will be FLAGGED, not deleted.
